shared_elements: border or band of repeated marks
justification: The main shared content is generic: both surfaces include schematic profile creature forms and repeated sign-like or geometric motifs arranged on an upright decorated field. The biggest difference is that B is organized around a prominent standing human-like figure with elaborate headdress and surrounding scroll/serpent motifs, while A is mainly a set of animal and geometric motifs in horizontal registers without the same central figural scheme.
